verdict_reason: The switch to code-keyed identifiers and species-keyed address is correct; the cap-reached refusal is silent and two rationale comments remain.

todos.issue: Rationale comments: lines 95-97 above capReachedResponse ('a stale form racing the engine-enforced cardinality link. Surface the rejection; never save silently.') and lines 123-124 above withEmptyFormGuard ('never append an empty record — name the gap instead') explain why and describe the UI action that calls them, not the lines below
todos.fix: Must: no rationale or caller-describing comments in forms.js; the function names carry the meaning. One way: delete both comments

todos.issue: capReachedResponse (lines 109-120) refuses an add on a line already at its declared count and re-renders, with no log line. A stale form being refused by an engine cap is not the trader's own input error, so support cannot see it happened or for which journey, line index and cap
todos.fix: Must: the cap-reached refusal logs once, at warn, with the journey id, the line index and the cap. One way: log in capReachedResponse before returning the render, using request.logger with { journeyId: request.params.journeyId, lineIndex: addIndex, cap }
